source.source_locator: 教則 第5章 5.2.1(1)5)「GNSSを使用しない操作」（教則表示ページ57 / PDF viewer 63）

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 緊急時にはGNSSによる位置推定に依存しない機体操作が求められる。
evidence.tested_misconception: GNSS喪失時は操縦者が介入せず自動制御だけに任せればよい。
evidence.reasoning_path: GNSS unavailable -> manual position-control capability -> emergency operation

collision.note: LOW。既存Q014-Q017はGNSS精度・waypoint、Q018-Q021は自動/手動切替であり、GNSS-off操作能力そのものは未出。

independent_review.rationale: 5.2.1 explicitly requires capability to operate without GNSS position estimation in an emergency. Existing GNSS questions concern accuracy/waypoint effects; auto/manual takeover questions do not test GNSS-independent operation itself.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review is source-consistent with the current MLIT 第5版 Chapter 5, preserves second-class scope, and correctly isolates one semantic duplicate. The other 19 candidates test distinct operational process, insurance/security, GNSS-off control, aircraft-specific takeoff/landing technique, human-error mitigation, CRM-skill, and assistant-role propositions with useful practice value. Near-neighbor candidates C004, C012, C014 and C020 remain distinct from the cited canonical questions because they require different causal or operational decision boundaries.
